entities.name: GroES Q0AVV0
observations: The 96-aa query sequence is an exact sequence-hash match to reviewed UniProt Q0AVV0 from Syntrophomonas wolfei subsp. wolfei.
GroES is a co-chaperonin that binds the apical surface of GroEL and caps its channel during ATP-dependent protein folding.
Pfam Cpn10 domain PF00166 spans query residues 2–95; reported cytoplasmic localization.
